name: Infosys Ltd
about: Infosys Ltd provides consulting, technology, outsourcing and next-generation digital services to enable clients to execute strategies for their digital transformation. [1] It is the 2nd largest Information Technology company in India behind TCS. [2]

sections.one_liner: India's #2 IT services firm. AI revenue grew 29% QoQ, but FY27 constant-currency growth guidance was cut twice, to 1–2%.
business: Sells IT services and consulting: platform modernisation, gen-AI implementation, data intelligence and managed services, built on the Topaz AI suite. [AR FY26]
Revenue split by segment and geography is not disclosed. The AR names six AI value pools but gives no figures for them. [AR FY26]
AI revenue was 10.5% of total in Q2FY27, up from 8.2% in Q1FY27. Over 328,000 employees at end-FY26. [Q2FY27 call] [Q4FY26 call]
Onsite mix is falling, now 22.6%. AI work covers 90% of the top-200 clients, with 4,600+ active AI projects. [Q2FY27 call] [AR FY26]
financial_snapshot: Sep-26 quarter: revenue ₹49,244cr, +10.7% YoY and +2.1% QoQ. PAT ₹7,838cr, up only 6.3% YoY. OPM 24%. [Numbers]
TTM: revenue ₹1,89,336cr, EBITDA ₹44,899cr (23.7%), PAT ₹30,788cr. PAT margin fell to 15.9% from 16.6% a year ago. [Numbers]
ROCE 40%, ROE 31.9%. At ₹1,185 the stock trades at 15.2x P/E and 4.9x book, with a 4.05% dividend yield. [Numbers]
Price is 31% below the ₹1,728 high and 21% above the ₹980 low. Market cap ₹4,80,908cr. [Numbers]
trajectory: Revenue CAGR halved from 12.2% (5y) to 6.8% (3y). FY26 grew 9.6% in rupees but only 3.1% in constant currency. [Numbers] [Q4FY26 call]
OPM fell from 28% to 24% over FY21–23, then held at 24% through FY26. All eight recent quarters were 23–24%. [Numbers]
PAT 5y CAGR of 8.7% trails revenue's 12.2% because of the margin loss. Over 3y, PAT (6.9%) and revenue (6.8%) grew in line. [Numbers]
Rupee YoY growth rose from 7.5% to 14.0% (Jun-25 to Jun-26), while constant-currency growth slowed to 2.4%. Reported growth flatters demand. [Numbers] [Q1FY27 call]
balance_sheet: Borrowings ₹8,525cr against net worth ₹99,077cr. D/E stayed at 0.09–0.10 from FY24 to Sep-26. The debt's nature is not disclosed. [Numbers]
Net worth fell ₹2,966cr in FY26 despite ₹29,474cr PAT, so payouts exceeded profit. Payout breakdown not disclosed. [Numbers]
Debtor days (72) make up the whole cash cycle, up from 63 in FY23. Working-capital days improved to 33 from 54 in FY24. [Numbers]
cash_quality: CFO/PAT averaged 1.15 over 3 years: 0.96 in FY24, 1.33 in FY25, 1.15 in FY26. Profits are turning into cash. [Numbers]
FCF rose from ₹19,888cr to ₹31,259cr over FY23–26 (16% CAGR). But FY26 FCF fell 6.6% while PAT rose 10.2%. [Numbers]
FY26 capex was about ₹2,700cr (CFO minus FCF), 1.5% of revenue. FCF was 116.5% of net profit in Q1FY27 and 113% in Q2FY27. [Numbers] [Q1FY27 call] [Q2FY27 call]
narrative_vs_numbers: Rupee revenue grew 10.7% YoY versus 1.5% in constant currency, a 9pp gap. The split between currency and acquisitions (Stratus, Optimum, Versent) is not disclosed. [Numbers] [Q4FY26 call]
AI share went from 8.2% to 10.5% while total grew 1.2% QoQ in constant currency. That implies non-AI revenue fell about 1.3% QoQ. [Q2FY27 call]
Large deals rose 28% in both FY26 ($14.9bn) and H1 ($8.8bn), yet growth guidance fell to 1–2%. Bookings are not converting into revenue. [Q4FY26 call] [Q2FY27 call]
Margin story matches the numbers: operating margin 21% and OPM 24% both flat. But Sep-26 PAT (+6.3%) lagged revenue (+10.7%), and the cause is not disclosed. [Numbers] [Q2FY27 call]
guidance: FY27 constant-currency growth is now 1–2%, down from 1.5–3% (Q1FY27) and 1.5–3.5% (Q4FY26). With H1 at 1.9%, H2 implies about 1.1%. [Q2FY27 call]
FY27 operating margin guided at 20–22%, unchanged across three calls. H2 faces October and January pay hikes, partly offset by Project Maximus. [Q2FY27 call]
The $2bn seven-year financial-services deal should add over 1% to FY28 revenue growth. [Q2FY27 call]
FY27 effective tax rate guided at 29–30%. Hiring target is about 20,000 freshers; 13,000 were hired in H1. [Q2FY27 call]
Capex guidance: not disclosed. FY26 run-rate was about ₹2,700cr, roughly 1.5% of revenue. [Numbers]

ledger.promised: Q4FY26 call: 1.5%–3.5% YoY constant-currency revenue growth.
ledger.delivered: H1 at 1.9% cc. Range cut to 1–2%, so the top end is gone. Rupee H1 revenue up 12.3%.

ledger.promised: Q1FY27 call: guidance lowered to 1.5%–3% constant-currency growth.
ledger.delivered: Cut again a quarter later to 1–2%. Q2 grew 1.5% YoY cc.
21.1% in Q1, 21% in Q2. OPM in Numbers 24% both quarters, flat YoY.

ledger.promised: Q4FY26 call: H1 stronger than H2, normal seasonality.
ledger.delivered: H2 not reported. Guidance implies about 1.1% H2 cc growth versus 1.9% in H1.

ledger.promised: Q4FY26 call: growth to accelerate in Financial Services and Energy/Utilities/Resources/Services.
ledger.delivered: No segment numbers. Only evidence is the $2bn financial-services mega deal; total cc growth slowed.

ledger.promised: Q4FY26 call: European manufacturing client ramp-down to cut revenue 0.75%–1%.
ledger.delivered: Not quantified since. Q1 cited a separate 50bps program termination plus soft European manufacturing.

ledger.promised: Q3FY26, Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 calls: hire about 20,000 college graduates.
ledger.delivered: 13,000 hired in H1 (65% of target). Target reaffirmed in Q2.

ledger.promised: Q2FY27 call: $2bn seven-year deal adds over 1% revenue growth.

bull: 15.2x P/E, 4.05% yield, 40% ROCE, and FCF over 100% of PAT for 3 years. Stock is 31% below its high. [Numbers]
AI revenue grew 29% QoQ to 10.5% of the mix. If that continues, AI could outgrow the roughly 1.3% QoQ legacy decline. [Q2FY27 call]
H1 TCV $8.8bn, +28% YoY and 62% net new. The $2bn deal adds over 1% to FY28 growth. [Q2FY27 call]
bear: Growth guidance cut twice in six months, midpoint from 2.5% to 1.5%. Management cites AI deflation, pricing, and a 2% offshoring/deal-walk drag. [Q2FY27 call]
Pricing pressure is broad-based and some client asks exceed return thresholds. AI deal margins not disclosed. [Q2FY27 call]
October and January pay hikes plus a weak H2 hit the 21% margin. PAT already lags revenue (+6.3% vs +10.7%). [Q2FY27 call] [Numbers]
questions: Of the 10.7% rupee growth, how much is currency, acquisitions, or organic?
How fast is non-AI revenue shrinking, and when does AI offset it?
What operating margin do AI deals and the $2bn mega deal carry versus 21%?
Why did debtor days rise from 63 to 72 since FY23?

annual_report.business: IT services and consulting company specializing in AI-driven enterprise transformation. Serves large global enterprises across sectors including telecom, automotive, CPG, banking, and cloud services. Generates revenue through platform modernization, generative AI implementation, data intelligence, and managed services leveraging Infosys Topaz AI suite.

segments.name: Not detailed
segments.comment: Six value pools referenced but not quantified in opening pages

annual_report.revenue_mix: Not stated in opening pages. Global client base implied through case studies (Europe: Liberty Global; Americas: Hertz, Microsoft; Netherlands: ABN AMRO).
strategy: Execute AI-First Value Framework with Infosys Topaz generative/agentic AI suite
Develop 30+ new AI service offerings across six value pools
Partner with 90% of top 200 clients on AI transformation journeys
Scale 4,600+ active AI projects with trusted delivery approach
Position as enterprise AI partner enabling measurable, responsible AI impact
annual_report.outlook: Company positioned as AI enabler for enterprise transformation. Statement 'we are ready to navigate your next' suggests confidence in sustained AI adoption demand. Focus on moving AI from pilots to operating substrate of enterprises.
